original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. actual_scope: Exact arbitrary positive complete-price envelope for the fixed five-source F2 all-31-mask dirty connector.
scope_change_reason: The alphabet and source count stay fixed. This answers the unequal-price decision beyond PR1770's one price vector, rather than adding an operation family.
bottleneck_link: A local interface side result: it decides exactly which complete source or output call can pay the unavoidable restoration surcharge. A selected supplier occurrence and moment transfer remain unknown.
stop_rule: Stop after the complete 945-word odd-mask obstruction, 16 attaining schedules and positive-price proof; no source-count expansion or supplier construction.
evidence: Two complete word generators and independent prefix implementations agree on 945 paths; every path misses a size-three or size-five mask. Sixteen 74-call schedules pass free-algebra and dense dirty-input action/inverse checks. See README.md and verify.py.
